result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up verification focused on convergence for prior finding S0-F001 and the directly touched verification surfaces: guard:no-test-changes behavior, package.json wiring, and configured gates. I did not perform a broad full-story re-review beyond the prior blocker and touched gate surface.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: The guard now explicitly checks unstaged, staged, and untracked test files via `git diff --name-only`, `git diff --cached --name-only`, and `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard` in `scripts/guard-no-test-changes.mjs:48-69`. Direct probes in a temporary clone returned exit 1 for untracked, unstaged, and staged relevant test changes, and the current repo probe reports `Staged test file changes detected: tests/context-workbench/foundation.test.ts`.

newFindings.title: Story gate currently fails because required staged foundation test changes trigger the fixed guard
newFindings.evidence: `package.json:15-19` wires `green-verify` to `npm run verify && npm run guard:no-test-changes`, and the fixed guard detects staged test changes. In the current story state, `git diff --cached --name-only -- 'tests/*.test.ts' 'tests/**/*.test.ts'` reports `tests/context-workbench/foundation.test.ts`; `npm run green-verify` runs all 116 unit tests successfully, then fails in `guard:no-test-changes` with `Staged test file changes detected: tests/context-workbench/foundation.test.ts`. This conflicts with the orchestrator follow-up requirement to both detect staged relevant test-file changes and have `npm run green-verify` pass when required Story 0 files are staged.

openQuestions: Should `green-verify` be run only after Story 0 test changes are committed/accepted into the baseline, or should `guard:no-test-changes` distinguish approved story test additions from later test edits? The current requirements ask it to both reject staged test changes and pass with staged Story 0 test files.
additionalObservations: The quick-fix closed the original trust gap: staged test changes are no longer silently ignored.
`npm run verify-all` passed independently: unit tests 116/116, integration tests 4/4, and e2e tests 24/24.
No production-path fake adapter, shim, placeholder branch, or non-real runtime path was introduced in the reviewed quick-fix surface; the touched code is verification tooling only.
